problem_text:
A logistics firm must coordinate a circuit of maintenance checks at nine distinct facilities, with the following geographical positions recorded on a grid:
Facility Alpha: Coordinates (175,106)
Facility Beta: Coordinates (7,127)
Facility Gamma: Coordinates (83,184)
Facility Delta: Coordinates (64,20)
Facility Epsilon: Coordinates (90,18)
Facility Zeta: Coordinates (31,91)
Facility Eta: Coordinates (177,7)
Facility Theta: Coordinates (88,89)
Facility Iota: Coordinates (45,2)

The travel distances between facilities, measured in kilometers, are precisely known:
Alpha to Gamma: 120.6 km
Alpha to Delta: 140.4 km
Alpha to Epsilon: 122.3 km
Alpha to Zeta: 144.8 km
Alpha to Eta: 99.0 km
Alpha to Theta: 88.6 km
Alpha to Iota: 166.5 km
Beta to Gamma: 95.0 km
Beta to Delta: 121.2 km
Beta to Epsilon: 137.0 km
Beta to Zeta: 43.3 km
Beta to Eta: 208.1 km
Beta to Theta: 89.5 km
Beta to Iota: 130.6 km
Gamma to Delta: 165.1 km
Gamma to Epsilon: 166.1 km
Gamma to Zeta: 106.6 km
Gamma to Eta: 200.4 km
Gamma to Theta: 95.1 km
Gamma to Iota: 185.9 km
Delta to Epsilon: 26.1 km
Delta to Zeta: 78.3 km
Delta to Eta: 113.7 km
Delta to Theta: 73.1 km
Delta to Iota: 26.2 km
Epsilon to Zeta: 93.9 km
Epsilon to Eta: 87.7 km
Epsilon to Theta: 71.0 km
Epsilon to Iota: 47.8 km
Zeta to Eta: 168.4 km
Zeta to Theta: 57.0 km
Zeta to Iota: 90.1 km
Eta to Theta: 121.0 km
Eta to Iota: 132.1 km
Theta to Iota: 97.0 km

Due to an unresolved access restriction, direct travel between Facility Alpha and Facility Beta is not permitted.
Furthermore, a specific routing directive mandates that exactly one of two designated corridors must be incorporated into the circuit: either the link between Facility Beta and Facility Gamma, or the link between Facility Gamma and Facility Delta.

The objective is to determine the most efficient closed-loop inspection tour, visiting every facility exactly once before returning to the origin, thereby minimizing the total distance traveled.
